title: dev-tasks project-config
description: Per-project configuration consumed by dev-tasks plugin hooks/skills. Lives at .claude/project-config.json in the consumer repo.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI reference. Ignored at runtime — exists so consumer files can declare their schema without triggering additionalProperties: false.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when making breaking changes to this schema.

defaultBase.description: Branch name PRs target by default (e.g., 'staging' or 'main').

hotfixBase.description: Branch hotfix PRs target. Usually 'main' even when defaultBase is 'staging'.

branchConvention.description: Template for new branch names. Use <slug> as placeholder.

autoMergePolicy.description: Per-branch auto-merge policy, enforced by the opt-in `auto-merge-policy-gate` hook (add it to hooks.enabled[] to activate). Keys are branch names, matched against a PR's TARGET (base) branch. Values: `never` / `manual-only` BLOCK an agent `gh pr merge` to that branch (a human must merge); `auto-after-checks-and-review` PERMITS the agent to merge — the review + CI gates still decide readiness, this only lifts the branch-level block. Branches absent from the map are unconstrained. An unrecognized value blocks (fail-safe), so a typo such as "manual"/"auto" can't silently disable the gate.

protectedBranches.description: Branch names that must never receive a direct `git push`. Enforced by bash-guard gate (f). Default: [main, staging, master, production, prod]. Set to [] to disable the gate while keeping the rest of bash-guard active.

enabled.description: Whether i18n parity checks run on edit/commit.

defaultLocale.description: Source-of-truth locale (other locales must contain its keys).

parityHookMode.description: How the parity check behaves on missing keys.

requiredChecks.description: Names of CI checks that gate the session-stop wait in stop-ci-green-check (v0.27.0): when non-empty and ≥1 name matches the PR's checks, only these checks block the pending/cancelled wait — optional lanes pending alone no longer hold the session. Empty/missing = any pending check blocks (conservative default). Does NOT affect the merge gate (GitHub branch protection governs merges), and a FAILED check always blocks regardless of this list.

previewUrlPattern.description: Python regex pattern that validates the `demoUrl` passed to updateTask when transitioning to Waiting for UAT (read by demo-url-required hook). Default `^https://` permits any HTTPS URL. Tighten per deploy platform (e.g. `^https://.*\.vercel\.app(/.*)?$`, `^https://test\.example\.com`).

autoSkip.description: Deterministic bounds for the per-task CI-gate auto-skip (Monday 'CI Gate' column → 'Skip (agent)'). plugin/scripts/ci-skip-eval.sh evaluates the committed diff against these bounds; only an ELIGIBLE verdict permits the agent to set 'Skip (agent)'. Skip removes the CI WAIT (pending-check stop block + e2e gates) — a RED check still blocks merge. Absent block = auto-skip never eligible ('Skip (human)' on the board still works).

enabled.description: Master switch for agent auto-skip eligibility. Default false — projects opt in explicitly.

maxChangedLines.description: Cap on total added+deleted lines across the diff (binary files count 0; renames count full add+delete).

pathAllowlist.description: fnmatch-style globs (`*` crosses directory separators). EVERY changed path must match at least one. Empty/absent = nothing eligible — allowlists are explicit opt-in (e.g. ["*.css", "*.md", "**/copy/**"]).

pathDenylist.description: fnmatch-style globs; ANY changed path matching one makes the diff ineligible. A configured list REPLACES the default — re-state the defaults if you extend. NOTE: `**/x/**` does NOT match root-level `x/...` under fnmatch; carry both forms (`x/**` and `**/x/**`) per guarded directory, as the default does.

productId.description: Monday Products-board item ID for this product (numeric string, e.g. "2723505568"). Used by skills to scope listEpics/getBacklog calls. Required.

v1MilestoneEpicIds.description: Epic IDs that must be Done before version-bump.ts allows v1.0+ patch increments. Replaces the hardcoded PolAds Beta/Live gate.

tasksBoardId.description: Monday Tasks-board ID (numeric string). Optional — defaults to the STEP Tasks board (5091706356). Read by the commit-id-gate hook to validate that commit-message #ids reference Tasks-board items.

environments.description: Where this product is deployed. Used by skills to surface UAT URLs in Monday updates and self-review prompts.

url.description: UAT environment URL (e.g., 'https://test.example.com'). Surfaced in log-progress, ship-pr Phase 6.7.

extraRules.description: Additional project-specific rule files (basenames in .claude/rules/) surfaced by the rule-autoload hook once per session, alongside the plugin's universal rules (which auto-load per rules-routing.json by file-glob). Basename-only — entries containing '/' or '..' are rejected.

e2e.description: Autonomous-UAT (Playwright) harness configuration. Consumed by /dev-tasks:write-uat-spec and /ship-pr Phase 4.6 to write per-task specs that walk the feature before transitioning to Waiting for UAT. Auth-agnostic — skill REFUSES on missing persona storageState rather than guessing.

enabled.description: Opt-in flag. When false, /ship-pr Phase 4.6 skips entirely (UAT doc notes 'autonomous UAT not configured'). Consumer projects opt in when they've completed the auth/storageState wiring + CI lane setup.

framework.description: E2E framework. Only 'playwright' supported in v1.

specDir.description: Root directory (relative to repo root) where specs live. Skill writes new specs under `<specDir>/<feature-area>/<short-slug>.spec.ts`.

baselineSnapshots.description: How visual baselines are stored. 'commit' → PNG baselines under `<specDir>/<area>/<slug>.spec.ts-snapshots/` are committed to the repo (default; never gitignore them — silently makes the gate a no-op). 'lfs' → Git LFS tracks them (recommended once total snapshot weight exceeds ~50MB).

baseUrl.description: BASE_URL targets for the spec runner. Spec MUST read `process.env.BASE_URL` in playwright.config.ts — never hardcode.

preview.description: Preview-environment URL. 'auto' → use the previewUrl from `.claude/active-task.json` (set by ship-pr Phase 4). Override only if the deploy platform exposes preview URLs in a non-standard place.

local.description: Local dev-server URL. Used when /dev-tasks:write-uat-spec is invoked with `--target=local` (dev iteration only — Phase 4.6 always uses preview for the hard gate).

personas.description: Test personas the skill can target. Each persona maps to a `storageState` file produced by the consumer's `e2e/auth.setup.ts`. `storageState: null` declares an unauthenticated persona (e.g. public-visitor). Skill REFUSES to write specs for an authenticated persona whose storageState is null/missing — no inline login walks.

storageState.description: Path (relative to repo root) to the storageState JSON file produced by auth.setup.ts. Use null for unauthenticated personas.

description.description: Human-readable description of the persona's role + capabilities. Helps the skill pick the right persona for a task.

humanOnlyChecks.description: Items that are NEVER agent-verifiable for this product — subjective design, copy tone, business-edge cases, cross-browser parity beyond default Chromium. Surfaced verbatim in the UAT doc's 'Human-only' section so the human's UAT focus is explicit.

flakyDir.description: Path (relative to repo root) where chronically-flaky specs go. Specs here still run in CI but with a non-failing reporter — they catch eventual regressions without blocking PRs. Use sparingly; flaky-quarantine is maintenance debt.

fullSuite.description: In-session FULL Playwright-suite run (v0.34.0), consumed by /dev-tasks:run-full-e2e and /ship-pr Phase 6.6. Runs the consumer's ENTIRE existing Playwright suite locally (in-session, sharded via --workers) against the consumer's STAGING URL (environments.uat.url) as an ADVISORY step AFTER the post-merge staging deploy is READY — so the suite executes on the dev machine instead of a per-preview GitHub Actions lane, reclaiming CI minutes. ADVISORY ONLY: it records pass/fail/skip; it NEVER blocks push, merge, or the Waiting-for-UAT transition. ON by default (opt-out), mirroring visualDiff.enabled: it auto-engages once a staging URL AND a real Playwright suite both exist, and otherwise short-circuits to a recorded no-op (one-line note, never an error). Independent of e2e.enabled — running an existing suite is not the same as authoring per-task specs; the safe-skip preconditions gate it instead. Distinct from the per-task spec gate (Phase 4.6/6.5), which is unchanged. Auth is owned entirely by the consumer's own playwright.config setup projects (e.g. auth.setup.ts) — the plugin injects NO personas/credentials for this run; specs whose secrets are absent locally self-skip (recorded).

enabled.description: Master switch. ON by default — set false to opt OUT. When false, /dev-tasks:run-full-e2e and the /ship-pr Phase 6.6 advisory sub-step skip entirely (recorded no-op). True alone does NOT force a run — the safe-skip preconditions (resolvable https staging URL + a real Playwright suite + a runnable command + ensurable browsers) must also hold, otherwise the step records a no-op and never errors.

target.description: Where the suite runs. 'staging' resolves the BASE_URL to environments.uat.url (the only v1 value — staging is stable, already-deployed, and auth-reachable without a per-PR deployment-protection bypass). 'preview' is reserved for a future version and is not yet honored.

command.description: Test command run by the e2e-tester subagent (the --workers flag is appended by the skill). Optional — when absent the skill derives it from package.json scripts (prefers a 'test:e2e' script, typically `pnpm test:e2e`). The consumer's playwright.config MUST read BASE_URL/PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL from env — never hardcode the target — so the skill can point the suite at staging. No runnable command resolves → recorded safe-skip.

workers.description: Playwright --workers value for the in-session run, trading machine cores for wall-clock (the whole point of running locally). Accepts a count (e.g. 4) or a percentage string (e.g. '50%'). v1 shards via --workers only; --shard=i/N is intentionally out of scope for a single in-session run.

recordTo.description: Where the advisory results land. 'uatDoc' appends a run summary to the task's UAT doc 'Agent-verified' section; 'mondayUpdate' posts a Monday update. Both are advisory records, never gates.

onRed.description: What happens when the suite goes red. 'record' (default) surfaces the failure loudly in the recorded results and continues. 'record+file-bug' ALSO files a follow-up bug via the plugin's auto-file path (createBug, source 'agent'). NEVER blocks — there is intentionally no 'block' value; this step cannot stall the pipeline.

visualDiff.description: Before/after UI-screenshot capture (v0.32.0; capture contract hardened v0.37.0), consumed by /ship-pr. When a UI-changing task ships, the agent screenshots the changed routes on staging BEFORE the change (pre-merge, Phase 2) and AFTER it deploys (post-merge, Phase 6.6), embedding both passes into a dedicated 'Visual Changes' Monday doc on the task (via the appendTaskVisualSnapshots tool). ON by default (opt-out): runs whenever a UI change is detected AND a staging URL resolves; otherwise it skips with a one-line note (never errors). The staging base URL is read from environments.uat.url. CAPTURE CONTRACT (v0.37.0): appendTaskVisualSnapshots embeds by absolute local imagePath, so an upload REQUIRES a capture tool that writes a file to disk — Playwright (`npx playwright screenshot`, consumes e2e.personas[].storageState via --load-storage) is the REQUIRED path for authed routes and the default for uploads generally; MCP browsers whose screenshots land only in model context (claude-in-chrome) may verify visually but can never feed an upload (their captures are recorded note-only, with an explicit reason). Per-route personas via routeMap[].persona (falls back to authPersona); loginUrl is the MCP-browser login fallback for consumers exposing a programmatic test-login route.

enabled.description: Master switch. ON by default — set false to opt OUT. When false, /ship-pr skips both visualDiff passes entirely.

viewports.description: Viewports captured per route. Mirrors the /visual-diff defaults: desktop (1440x900) + mobile (390x844), full page.

maxRoutes.description: Safety cap on how many changed routes are screenshotted per task. When the diff implicates more routes, the skill captures the top maxRoutes and logs which were dropped (silent truncation reads as full coverage).

authPersona.description: DEFAULT e2e persona id (from e2e.personas[].id) whose storageState authenticates the headless browser for authed routes — a routeMap entry's `persona` overrides it per route (v0.37.0). null = public/unauthenticated capture only; authed routes without a resolvable persona are skipped with a noted reason rather than guessing a login.

loginUrl.description: Optional programmatic test-login URL template (v0.37.0) for consumers that expose a mint-a-session-by-URL route (e.g. a non-prod /api/dev/test-login). Visited in the capture browser BEFORE an authed-route capture when the tool in use cannot consume Playwright storageState (MCP browsers); Playwright captures keep using e2e.personas[].storageState as the primary mechanism. HARD CONSTRAINT (SSRF guard): the URL's origin MUST equal the environments.uat.url origin — /ship-pr refuses to navigate anywhere else, and never to a host derived from task/PR text. Placeholders: {persona} → the resolving persona id; {secret} → the value of the env var named by loginSecretEnv, substituted AT NAVIGATION TIME and never written to config, logs, the PR, or the Monday doc. null = no login URL; an authed MCP-browser capture without one records a note-only entry.

loginSecretEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the shared secret substituted for {secret} in loginUrl (v0.37.0). Only the VARIABLE NAME lives in config — the value stays in the consumer's env. If loginUrl contains {secret} but this is null or the variable is unset at capture time, the login URL is unusable and the capture skips with a note (never guesses, never errors).

routeMap.description: Optional fallback for routes the agent can't infer from the diff alone (dynamic/[param] routes). Each entry maps a changed-file glob to the concrete route path(s) to screenshot, with params resolved to real sample values. The agent reasons from the diff by default and only consults this map when present.

glob.description: fnmatch-style glob matched against changed file paths.

routes.description: Concrete route paths to screenshot when the glob matches (e.g. ['/posts/sample-slug']).

persona.description: Optional e2e persona id (from e2e.personas[].id) that authenticates THESE routes' captures, overriding visualDiff.authPersona (v0.37.0). Use when different surfaces need different roles — e.g. an admin dashboard route captured as an admin persona while a user-facing wizard route uses a regular-user persona. Omitted → authPersona applies.

review.description: Review-gate configuration for the pre-merge-review-gate hook and the /ship-pr review loop.

sources.description: Which review sources this project uses. The pre-merge-review-gate hook only enforces POLISH-decline-reply checks for listed sources. "localReview" (v0.28.0) is the /ship-pr Phase 2 step 6.7 local multi-lens panel — its findings are recorded in reviewAddressed.sources.localReview with the same shape as the bot sources. Default: ["claudeBot", "corridor", "selfReview"].

cloudBot.description: When the GitHub Claude review bot runs relative to the /ship-pr loop (v0.28.0). "always" = today's behavior — the bot reviews every push and Phase 6 waits for it each round. "final-push" = the local review panel (Phase 2 step 6.7) carries the iteration rounds and the bot reviews ONCE on the final pushed state as a safety net — Phase 6 waits for exactly one bot review on the last push. "off" = no bot wait at all (repos without the bot installed). QUALITY GATE: a project may only move from "always" to "final-push" after the local panel passes the parity benchmark (covers all bot BLOCKERs on ≥5 historical PRs — see ship-pr SKILL.md "Local review panel"). The pre-merge review gate and CI-green requirements are unaffected by this setting.

reviewerTimeoutSeconds.description: How long /babysit-prs waits for the last configured reviewer to post before failing loudly (default: 600 = 10 minutes).

hooks.description: Per-project hook activation for non-policy hooks. Policy hooks (bash-guard, stop-ci-green-check) are STEP-wide and always-on regardless of this list. Listing them here is harmless (kept in the enum for backward compatibility with existing project-configs).

exemptPaths.description: Path prefixes (relative to repo root) exempt from task-state-guard. Files under these paths can be edited without an active Monday task. The built-in exemptions (.claude/, memory/, CLAUDE.md, .gitignore) always apply regardless of this list.

enabled.description: Names of opt-in plugin hooks active in this project. `bash-guard` and `stop-ci-green-check` are accepted but ignored at runtime — they are always-on STEP policy hooks. Drop them from the array when convenient.
